entries.title: Psalms 71:7
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: A wonder - For my many and sore calamities.

entries.title: Psalms 71:15
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: The numbers - Of thy salvations and mercies vouchsafed to me.

entries.title: Psalms 71:16
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Make mention - To support and comfort myself with the remembrance of it. Righteousness - Of thy faithfulness in making good all thy promises.
